tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// drang srong dri med kyi sngags rgod log tri pā la'i lo rgyus bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru padma kro tā ya/ 1$0000250sngags rgod log tri pā la'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon rgya gar lho phyogs ind+ra'i yul na rgyal po dha na a shwa'i rgyal khrims rnams mi ngan rnams kyis bshigs pas/ rgyal pos sde brgyad klu'i gtad khram mang du byas nas mi ngan rnams phung ngo*// de nas sde brgyad kyi 'khu ldog byung nas rgyal po khrag tu skyugs/ lus mdze nad kyis thebs nas glo snying me ltar 'bar te sdug bsngal pa las/ mo dpyad mkhan rnams na re/ nags tshal drwa ba can gyi phug ces bya ba stag gzig dug sbrul gyi tshal mi mi thar ba na/ drang srong dri med ces bya ba bden tshig grub pa yod de/ zla ba nya yi nyin ri kun 'dus kyi rtse la byon nas/ drang srong 'bum phrag la chos ston pas de spyan drangs na nad la phan zer bas/ de bkug pas drang srong rgan po ag tshom can ras dkar po'i smad dkris can zhig 'dug pa spyan drangs bsnyen bkur lo rgyus zhus pas/ der 1$0000300 1$0000250'bru dang chang zan gyi gtor ma rgya chen po shoms gsungs nas/ drang srong 'bum phrag la gtor ma btang zhing smon lam dmod sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pas rgyal po'i nad sos par gyur te/ drang srong rang gnas su bzhud do// rgyal po de la bram ze legs grub kyis zhus/ de la bram ze pra chen hastis zhus/ de la shānta rakṣi tas zhus/ de la slob dpon padmas zhus/ o rgyan rin po ches gter kha mang po la rgyas bsdus mang du sbas pa/ rgyas pa ni lho brag mkho mthing nas gu ru chos dbang gis gter nas bton pas/ kaḥthog gi bla ma byang chub rin chen gyis gser zho bcu gsum phul nas zhus te dar srol che/ gzhan yang ratna lugs kyi gur drag gi sngags kyi rno so la'ang sngags 'di dang dmod pa yod do// 'di ni bram ze'i sngags rgod sde brgyad log tri pā la'i sngags kyi rgyud/ he ru brgyad pa lung gi rgyud/

rin po che phreng ba rgyan gyi rgyud gsum yod do// 1$0000300 'di ni ratna lugs kyi gur drag las tshogs rno so la sbyar rgyu'i sngags dang dmigs rim nyung ngur bsdus pa 'di lta ste/ e: rang nyid skad cig khro bo nag po ni: zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis pad zlar bgrad: g.yas g.yon dang pos tho ba ral gri phyar: tha ma gnyis kyis nyi zla thal mo rdeb: spyi bor bla ma padma 'byung gnas sku: phrag gong g.yas su drang srong dri med ni: phyag gnyis ril ba lung thang phreng ba 'dzin: skra dang ag tshom dkar po phyed skyil bzhugs: rang gi thugs kar gu ru drag po yi: thugs dbus hūm̐ nang bsrung bya thams cad gsal: dam ye dbyer med lce rtsa zla ba'i steng: lce ni gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i: lte bar hūm̐ dmar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: rtse dgu'i phaṭa las me 'phros gnod byed bsregs: phyi rol 'khor lo 'byung bzhi spu gri'i gur: de ltar bsgom zhing nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ traṃ du tri na traṃ du dzaḥdzaḥ khri 'am 'bum mam yang na zhag bdun bzla/ de nas dgu yi dus sam rgyun du ni/ thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyus gnod byed bkug: dgra bgegs spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram mnan: 'gul dbang med cing khas blangs thal sbyor phul: oṃ log tri pā la nan: sa ga pā sha nan: nā ga du du nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsi tsa ra tsi tsa ra: rbad ru lu rbad ru lu: rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya: ho ra ho ra: tsi du sod tsi du sod: shigs lhu ru gtubs: ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba thul bdag la gnod byed kā wā tsi brlag brlag: bdun nam gsum sogs brjod pa rgyun du bya/ lag gnyis rdo rje'i brag ri nyi zla bcas: brdab pas dgra bgegs khrag skyo ltar gyur pa: sor mo lcags sdig mgo dgus ljib ljib zos: zhes pas thal mo brdab cing*/ drang srong gi dmod mo 'di tshar gcig brjod par bya/ gnod byed 'byung po bka' ltar mi byed cing dam la mi gnas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig:

srid pa spyi nas shigs shig: srid gsum rming nas sgyel cig: 'khor ba steng nas phyungs shig: bskal pa'i me la sregs shig: dam tshig gi dmod pas sdigs shig: bka' yi chad pa chod cig: gnas lcags thog gi ral gris spyi bo nas khos shig: srid gsum gar gnas kyang lus la mtshon cha'i char phob cig: dam nyams 'byung po las ngan mna' zan 'di'i mgo bo tshal pa stong du khos shig: lus dum bu stong du thongs shig: snying dum bu brgyad du gtubs shig: mig 'bras thang du lhung zhig: snying khrag las mkhan rnams kyi dpa' zas gyis shig: dam nyams ru dra 'di mtha'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu sgrol cig: gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭa sod cig: drang srong dmod pa sus kyang bzlog tu med// rgyun du gtor ma la sogs mi dgos te// dus bzang nya mtshams la sogs gtor ma ni// rin chen snod du gtor ma dkar gsum dang*// 'bru sna blugs la 'bru gsum byin brlabs te// hūm̐: rgya gar lho phyogs ind+ra'i yul dbus na: ri bo kun 'dus nags tshal drwa ba can: 'byung lnga'i gur nas drang srong dri ma med: drang srong 'bum dang 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: rin chen khri dang pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: oṃ traṃ du tri na traṃ du dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa sna bdun dang: 'dod yon lnga dang dkar gsum gtor ma 'di: drang srong dri med drang srong 'bum bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes pa chen por bzhes nas kyang: dmod pa drag pos dgra bgegs tshar gcod mdzod: oṃ traṃ du tri na traṃ du dza dza: khā hi du na swā hā: drang srong rnams kyi zhal du khā hi khā hi: arghaṃ pādyaṃ sogs/ shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul drang srong dri med ni: bram ze'i gzugs can ril ba phreng ba 'dzin: thor tshugs ag tshom dkar zhing 'khor tshogs bcas: khros tshe khro bo nag po phyag bzhi pa:

tho ba ral gri thal mos gnod byed 'dul: zhi rgyas dbang drag sku mdog cir yang bsgyur: srid gsum 'di na che btsan 'gran bral bas: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bdag la gnod byed thal ba rdul du rlogs: rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces brjod gtor ma gtsang sar phul// lha 'dre la sogs ci ltar stobs che yang*// 'di yis brlag 'gyur the tshom med par gsungs// 'di yi lung sogs man ngag sbyin pa'i dus// drang srong la yang gtor ma phul byas la// slob mas gos kyang mgo mjug bsgyur nas gyon// gur drag las tshogs yin phyir 'di nyid kyi// bka' gtad logs su ma thob na yang rung*// gu ru drag po'i lhan thabs gsal ba'i phyir// rnal 'byor rā ga a syas zhes bya bas// rgyud gzhung rgyas pa'i don bsdus zab par byas// maṅga laṃ/// /
